# Guide Alpha

## 7. Measurement Sources

Prefer a live measurement over a recalled one.

## 8. Measured Anchors, Not Recalled Ones

### 8.1 Illustrative Example

The example below names a sibling reference with a hardcoded line count, which goes
stale the moment that file is edited:

```
See guide-beta.md (259 lines) for the full derivation.
```

Rewrite it to name the section by symbol instead of by count.

### 8.2 Why Counts Rot

A count is a measurement of a moment, not a property of a file.

## 9. Escalation

Escalate when the anchor cannot be resolved by symbol.
